translations.web: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
translations.bsb: In the time of evil they will not be ashamed, and in the days of famine they will be satisfied.
translations.kjv: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
translations.asv: They shall not be put to shame in the time of evil; And in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
